originalTitle: Borrowers expecting mortgage rates to drop have hopes dashed
summary: Major lenders have raised rates on new deals in recent days, leaving many borrowers needing to make a decision.
content:
Nearly all the major mortgage lenders in the UK have announced increases in the cost of home loans in recent days.

Analysts are uncertain over whether there are more to come, but are urging people who need to find a new deal to act now.

Someone whose five-year deal is coming to an end faces paying more than £5,000 more a year on their next deal under a typical rate, if they borrow the same amount of money.

Many lenders allow people to lock in a new deal six months before their current one comes to an end, with an opportunity to switch if the costs come down before it kicks in.

"Borrowers expecting mortgage rates to drop in the coming weeks have had their hopes dashed," said Rachel Springall, from financial information service Moneyfacts.

"It is still essential borrowers do not delay seeking advice to navigate the mortgage maze."

Interest rates fluctuate based on the Bank of England's base rate and market conditions

For borrowers, the interest rate on a fixed mortgage does not change until it expires, usually after two or five years, and a new one is chosen to replace it. The vast majority of homeowners and buyers have this kind of mortgage.

Since the Iran war began, global economic uncertainty has pushed up the cost of deals.

Speaking to MPs on the Treasury Committee, Bank of England governor Andrew Bailey said UK borrowers had seen the biggest rise in mortgage rates, apart from Japan, since the conflict started than in other countries in the G7 group of major economic powers.

Someone on a typical two-year deal, and borrowing £250,000 is likely to pay £120 more a month in mortgage repayments than they would have had they secured the deal at the start of March when the US-Israeli strikes began, according to Moneyfacts.

More recently, UK government borrowing costs have been rising , which has a knock-on impact on mortgage rates.

That pressure has been maintained in the latest sale of debt by the UK on Tuesday. A 30-year bond issued by the UK was sold with a yield - or interest rate - of 5.82%, the highest since 1998.

The situation has resulted in several major lenders raising their rates in the last few days.

"The difficult bit is knowing whether this is the end or just the first round of increases," said David Hollingworth, from broker L&C.

Aaron Strutt, of broker Trinity Financial, said: "Hopefully this will be the end of the rate rises for a while, but there are certainly no guarantees.

"Multiple small mortgage price rises add up and ultimately deter people from buying homes."

Potential buyers and borrowers are being urged to seek advice and plan early.

Latest data from the Bank of England , external shows that more buyers are taking loans with smaller deposits, leaving them more exposed to rate changes.

The proportion of mortgages where the loan is more than 90% of the value of the home has reached its highest level in 18 years.

The latest moves on mortgage rates will be a further blow to those who are coming off much cheaper five-year deals.

However, rates are still some way short of their peaks of recent years, and how much people can borrow, and at what rate, depends considerably on their circumstances.

Moneyfacts said that, as of Tuesday, the average rate on a new, two-year deal was 5.65%. On a five-year product, the average was 5.70%.

chineseTitle: 预计抵押贷款利率下降的借款人的希望破灭了
chineseSummary: 最近几天，主要贷方提高了新交易的利率，使许多借款人需要做出决定。
chineseContent:
最近几天，英国几乎所有主要抵押贷款机构都宣布提高住房贷款成本。

分析师不确定是否还会有更多协议，但敦促需要寻找新协议的人立即采取行动。

五年期合同即将结束的人，如果借入相同金额的资金，则在通常利率下，下一份合同每年要多支付 5,000 英镑以上。

许多贷方允许人们在当前协议结束前六个月锁定新协议，如果成本在协议生效前下降，则有机会进行转换。

金融信息服务 Moneyfacts 的雷切尔·斯普林戈尔 (Rachel Springall) 表示：“预计抵押贷款利率在未来几周内下降的借款人的希望已经破灭。”

“借款人仍然必须立即寻求建议来应对抵押贷款迷宫。”

我的抵押贷款付款可能会发生多少变化？

按照这个速度，您的付款可能会发生变化……

您提供的每月付款信息不足以在给定的年份内还清您的抵押贷款。

该计算器不构成财务建议。它基于标准抵押贷款还款公式，该公式取决于抵押贷款规模和期限以及固定利率。它仅供参考，并不代表抵押贷款优惠对用户的适用性、资格或可用性。如需确切数字，用户需要联系官方抵押贷款机构。

利率根据英格兰银行的基准利率和市场状况而波动

对于借款人来说，固定抵押贷款的利率在到期之前不会发生变化，通常是在两年或五年后，然后选择新的抵押贷款来取代它。绝大多数房主和买家都有这种抵押贷款。

自伊朗战争爆发以来，全球经济的不确定性推高了交易成本。

英国央行行长安德鲁·贝利对财政委员会议员表示，自冲突爆发以来，英国借款人的抵押贷款利率涨幅是除日本之外最大的，比七国集团主要经济强国中的其他国家还要高。

根据 Moneyfacts 的数据，与 3 月初美以罢工开始时签订的协议相比，签订典型的两年期协议并借款 25 万英镑的人每月可能要多支付 120 英镑的抵押贷款还款。

最近，英国政府借贷成本不断上升，这对抵押贷款利率产生了连锁反应。

英国周二最新的债务出售继续保持着这种压力。英国发行的 30 年期债券的收益率（或利率）为 5.82%，为 1998 年以来的最高水平。

这种情况导致几家主要贷方在过去几天提高了利率。

经纪商 L&C 的 David Hollingworth 表示：“困难之处在于要知道这是否是结束或只是第一轮上涨。”

经纪商 Trinity Financial 的亚伦·斯特拉特 (Aaron Strutt) 表示：“希望加息将在一段时间内结束，但肯定不能保证。

“多次小额抵押贷款价格上涨加起来最终会阻止人们购房。”

我们敦促潜在的买家和借款人尽早寻求建议和计划。

英国央行外部的最新数据显示，越来越多的买家以较少的存款获得贷款，这使他们更容易受到利率变化的影响。

贷款占房屋价值90%以上的抵押贷款比例达到18年来的最高水平。

抵押贷款利率的最新举措将对那些正在享受更便宜的五年期贷款的人造成进一步打击。

然而，利率仍远低于近年来的峰值，人们可以借多少钱以及利率是多少，在很大程度上取决于他们的情况。

Moneyfacts 表示，截至周二，新的两年期交易的平均利率为 5.65%。对于五年期产品，平均值为 5.70%。
